about: A Vital preset is JSON text. settings holds every control by name in the synth's own units, the modulations (source and destination by name), the three oscillators' wavetables (keyframes whose frames are base64 32-bit floats), the eight LFO shapes and the sample (base64 16-bit PCM). Read from Vital's published source; none of its code is in Kumi.

layers: JSON text, UTF-8, written in one line: author, comments, preset_name, preset_style, macro1 to macro4, synth_version and settings
the preset's JSON with the tuning added under tuning, written as a string with a closing NUL; the plug-in framework (JUCE) appends its own data after the NUL

the VST3 build hands its host that chunk wrapped as its VST2 build's: 'VstW' (big-endian: size 8, version 1, bypass), then an .fxb bank ('CcnK', size, 'FBCh', version 2, plug-in ID 'Vita', plug-in version, program count, current program, 124 reserved bytes, the chunk's size) and the chunk
Live keeps the VST3 state as hex in a Set's Vst3Preset/ProcessorState (and writes it as a .vstpreset's Comp chunk when the device is dragged into its browser); a VST2 chunk goes in VstPreset/Buffer

macro1.about: macro 1's name (macro2 to macro4 likewise); 'MACRO 1' when unnamed

preset_name.about: the preset's name; Vital sets it from the file name when saving

preset_style.about: the preset's style: Bass, Lead, Keys, Pad, Percussion, Sequence, Experiment, SFX or Template

settings.about: every control by name, and the parts that aren't controls
